verify.summary: Root independently reran 47 tests with actual PostgreSQL concurrency observations, mypy and lint; inspected task-specific delta and two fresh Luna co-reviews. FT-003-AC-022 passes.

Independent semantic review found no material break in concurrent admission, insert ownership, worker Session lifetime, terminal replay or atomic publication. One fresh Luna xhigh co-review approved; second launch failed twice at thread limit under permitted fallback.
Audit finding 2 closed after root-owned actual PostgreSQL concurrency verification, 47 tests and separate semantic-pass. No production deployment is part of this card.

title: Keep concurrent realtime admission responsive during inference
purpose: Correct audit finding 2 at the real endpoint while preserving the accepted singleton and duplicate-attempt contract under concurrent worker threads.
success_outcome: Blocking realtime work runs off the event loop in worker-local Sessions; a distinct key returns busy and an existing active key returns in_progress before the first inference completes, with one inference owner per key and effective existing rate limits.
anti_goals: Do not replace the semaphore, add an inference waiter queue, process/distributed workers, durable replay, new Attempt state or schema migration.
Do not change model inference, search/ranking, deadline policy, result/session semantics or client behavior.
Do not rewrite the already thread-safe auth limiter or re-prove complete historical FT-004/FT-003 acceptance.

forbidden_scope: Deployment/worker-count changes, models, client files, migrations and credentials/settings writes
Auth/limiter production implementation; it already guards its entire reserve operation with threading.Lock
Other audit findings, new response/domain contracts and production acceptance
stop_conditions: Preserving busy/idempotency requires an unaccepted queue, lease, second process or new durable state.
Concurrent admission cannot distinguish the insert winner without violating existing repository callers or accepted owner boundaries.
A required fix expands outside the hard write boundary or changes accepted result/session atomicity.

constraints: Primary owner is promo; serving_control supplies read-only auth/context, processing is called only through the existing search application boundary, and diagnostics remains best-effort. Use the accepted participant-promo graph edges.

Read the bounded request body on the event loop, then pass copied body/header/IP/state inputs to one synchronous operation via Starlette run_in_threadpool. Create, use and close every SQLAlchemy Session within that worker. Preserve TASK-112 auth/rate-before-parse/decode ordering. Do not hand a live Session across threads or move domain decisions into a generic thread helper.

Keep the existing process-local BoundedSemaphore(1) and nonblocking acquisition. The threadpool is the framework transport executor, not an inference waiting mechanism; the competing request must execute admission and return busy while the owner is still blocked in search.

Initial existing-key lookup must not take FOR UPDATE behind the inference transaction. Preserve the unique key and expose inserted-versus-existing admission from the promo repository with compatibility for existing create_or_get callers; only the insert winner enters processing. A uniqueness-conflict loser returns its stored terminal/in_progress response without a second lock/update held until inference. A short unique-insert arbitration before the initial committed admission is allowed; waiting on inference is not.

The current DisplayClientRateLimiter.allow already uses threading.Lock over prune/check/reserve. Keep production implementation; verify simultaneous same-token and same-IP callers respect the configured positive budget. Existing client-timing handler shares this limiter and remains a regression consumer, not a new work item.

Use the real ASGI app, production repositories and task-owned fresh migrated PostgreSQL from existing test fixtures; models/search may be replaced with bounded controlled calls. Never infer row-lock safety from SQLite or only fake Sessions. Use finite waits and always release barriers/close Sessions/drop only the fixture database on failure.

Keep result/session publication atomic and detailed evidence best-effort. Preserve no-proposals, deadline, exception cleanup, terminal replay, readiness and standard error mappings. Execution records RED before edits, then verify and per-task red-verify precede owner closure.
invariants: One committed promo_attempts row exists per (spa_id, client_attempt_id); only its admission creator invokes processing.
A duplicate active key never changes its owner to busy and never waits for inference-held row locks.
One inference slot remains process-local; competing distinct keys receive their own admitted busy terminal outcome.
Sessions never cross concurrent worker threads; auth budgets remain atomic; rejected requests retain TASK-112 decoder protection.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-022 / REQ-REL-001: drive concurrent real ASGI requests with a bounded search barrier; while first inference is held, assert health/heartbeat completion and distinct-key HTTP 200 busy before release, one processing call and separate committed Attempt rows. Use event ordering as verdict; report timing diagnostically without inventing a new product millisecond SLO.

FT-003-AC-022: with real PostgreSQL cover an already active duplicate and simultaneous first requests of the same key, including both initial reads missing before unique insertion. Require in_progress before first inference release, exactly one owner/row, unchanged active owner state and identical stored terminal replay afterwards.

FT-003-AC-022 / REQ-SEC-001: synchronized token/IP limiter calls admit exactly the configured budget; preserve GREEN if the existing Lock already passes. Track distinct worker-local Session/thread identities and ensure every Session closes on success and raised failure.

Exercise controlled success, processing exception and deadline with subsequent fresh requests proving semaphore release; verify accepted result/session atomicity and existing standard status/no-proposals cases through focused regression tests. These support this transport integration delta, not a new ownership claim over historical FT-004 proofs.

Read/write assertions target face_moment.promo_attempts and existing promo session rows in the isolated fixture DB. Release blocked calls in finally, dispose engines and force-drop only the generated database; retain a redacted trace without credentials or personal media.
evidence_required: FT-003-AC-022 RED: current async route serializes two blocking searches, delaying heartbeat and failing timely busy; GREEN: first inference stays held while health and distinct-key busy complete, duplicate active/racing keys return in_progress without a second inference or changed owner, all Sessions remain worker-local and subsequent fresh work runs after cleanup; decisive comparison: barrier/response order, search count, per-key PostgreSQL rows and Session/thread trace; artifact: real-route concurrency transcript under .tasks/TASK-113-T3-FT-003-W5/.

FT-003-AC-022 RED/GREEN: preserve honest pre-implementation GREEN for the existing locked limiter when concurrent token/IP reservation already admits exactly the configured budget; after moving auth into workers the same budget remains enforced; decisive comparison: allowed/denied counts under synchronized callers; artifact: focused limiter regression transcript under .tasks/TASK-113-T3-FT-003-W5/.
